title: RBL Bajaj Finserv Platinum Edge Supercard (Freedom) credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A co-branded Bajaj Finserv Platinum Edge Supercard from RBL offering EMI conversion, cashback on spends, and milestone vouchers, tailored for financing convenience.

eligibility: Spends of INR 15,000 (or more) made in the preceding calendar quarter will unlock the lounge access for the subsequent quarter.
